column1: # BAL-C275WL (14 Oct 2026): glossed runs of the Baluze 167 f.127 Memoire (c274-276, f.134r-135v by c=2f+6), read by this worker's eye
# from openapi.bnf.fr full/2400, images (untracked; regen URLs in ../images/manifest.json bal_c275wl_fetches). One row per cipher sign
# whose gloss unit I could place; signs I could not place are omitted. sign: N' acute, N unmarked; shapes: s:i i-stroke, s:dloop
# d with loop, s:u4 u4-form (crossed or not, not separable at 2400 px), L:w w-form, L:h h-form, L:longs long-s, s:pbar p with bar,
# s:c c-like stroke. gloss = the period interlinear word(s); unit = the letter/syllable I align to this sign.
